subject: Weekly bridge: exec asks & Q3 review prep
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: ethan@atlashealth.com
Date: 2027-07-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Weekly bridge: exec asks & Q3 review prep

Morning team —

Quick note ahead of the 10:30 alignment call: execs asked for a short, reconciled set of asks we can present in the Q3 readiness slot next week. Objective is to surface risks that might impact SLA commitments and to get sign-off on one prioritized mitigation per risk.

Please see the attached Q3_exec_prep.xlsx. I sketched three categories: Capacity, Model Quality, and Compliance. For today I need two things from each of you:

- One line stating the top risk your team owns (bullet, 1 sentence)
- One proposed mitigation and the owner for that mitigation (who will do it, by when)

Quick deadlines: please reply inline by 12:00 PT so I can fold into the synthesis before the call. If there are items that require sales/contract visibility include Ethan in the line.

High-level asks for the call:
- Agree the top three exec asks to share with Leadership (we'll pick from your inputs)
- Confirm who owns the mitigation and that timelines are realistic for commit

Thanks — short and concrete pls.

Jonas
Head of Product Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Q3_exec_prep.xlsx (spreadsheet - three tabs: risks, mitigations, open_decisions)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly bridge: exec asks & Q3 review prep

Jonas —

Top risk (Product): Model regressions on the new quantized LLM variant during long-tail dialogues. We saw two customers hit regressions in the last ingest window; impact is increased latencies and token-cost spikes when we fall back.

Proposed mitigation: Enable a 2-week canary on Dedicated for the quantized variant with live-metrics gating (latency + rollback threshold). Owner: laura.bennett. Timeline: canary start 2027-07-18, verdict by 2027-07-31.

Note: I attached a short excerpt to the sheet and added a row in the decision_matrix.pdf (tab: model_risks). If we escalate beyond canary we should consider temporary fallback to the previous quant profile — ops impacts included.

Laura
Sr. PM, Model Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachment: decision_matrix.pdf (excerpt added)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, ethan@atlashealth.com
Date: 2027-07-11T12:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly bridge: exec asks & Q3 review prep

Adding Product Ops + CS perspective —

Top risk (Customer/CS lens): Insufficient mutual action plan clarity for large customers on Dedicated migrations; procurement stalls when security checkpoints are unclear. Atlas Health highlighted the need for a single-runbook they can reference.

Proposed mitigation: Create a 1-pager migration runbook and a triaged checklist for procurement. Owner: marissa.cole to produce draft; review: ethan@atlashealth.com. Timeline: draft 2027-07-14, pilot with Atlas by 2027-07-20.

Also attaching a very rough draft of the Q3 presentation deck (slides_draft_v1.pptx) — please don't edit in place; I'll circulate a cleaner version post-call.

Marissa
Customer Success Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachment: slides_draft_v1.pptx (slides - v1, internal draft)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: ethan@atlashealth.com, maya.singh@vendorco.io
Date: 2027-07-11T15:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly bridge: exec asks & Q3 review prep

Thanks — quick flag on an exception that needs an exec decision: the Dedicated autoscale burst policy currently lacks a cost cap for X-region when partner capacity is used (VendorCo infra). If we enable the canary Laura suggested we'll need a temporary per-customer cap to avoid large overage exposure.

Proposed mitigation: Short-term policy: per-customer burst cap = 2x committed baseline for the canary period; require finance sign-off for exceptions. Owner: karthik.iyer (policy), finance review: tina_liao@redwood.com. Timeline: policy drafted by 2027-07-13, internal review 2027-07-15.

If execs agree we can surface this as one ask (approve temporary caps + finance guardrails) and include the runbook Marissa is drafting.

—
Karthik Iyer
Head of Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
